text: Wow. Well, they can certainly think that, can't they? If you are being there for a little one only when something is wrong, well, Protector might want to concede the point. It's not as if the point of what Protector does is to be protective, right? Little ones aren't stupid, and if a little one can see that, well, maybe it's a good idea to take it as a gift and realize that they might just be waiting for a time when you can be there and just enjoy them.
